# NYX Suede Matte Lip Liner in Cannes / Glitz

Define your lips with a suede matte lip liner that glides on with precision and stays put through your day.

## Precise, Matte Definition

The NYX Suede Matte Lip Liner features a soft matte finish that outlines and fills the lips for a clean, defined look. Its formula is designed to hold its shape, so you can wear it alone or under your favorite lipstick. A standard sharpener keeps the tip ready for detailed application.

## Long-Lasting Wear

The matte texture helps color stay on the lips, so you spend less time reapplying and more time enjoying your look.

## Express Your Personal Style

Lip color is a simple way to show your personality. Whether you prefer a polished everyday look or a bolder statement, this shade adds a versatile touch to your makeup routine and can help you feel confident in how you present yourself.

## Strong Value, Brand New

Each liner arrives brand new, original, and factory sealed. With generous size for the price, it's a practical addition to any beauty collection.

## Add It to Your Routine

Shop the NYX Suede Matte Lip Liner today and find the shade that fits your style.
